notes: IndustrialPlanner is treated as a viewer/editor target, not as a certified proof sink.
The current exporter is one-way and may be lossy for generic facilities, dual-layer routing, and exact-only metadata.

direct_mappings.reason: canonical export timestamp is preserved in the target blueprint root

lossy_mappings.reason: unresolved generic canonical facility templates fall back to representative IndustrialPlanner device ids with explicit warnings

dropped_fields.reason: viewer/editor target does not carry exact-proof iteration metadata
viewer/editor target has no certified solve-time field
IndustrialPlanner blueprints do not model the certified empty-rectangle objective payload

derived_mappings.reason: target blueprint baseId is chosen from exporter options instead of a canonical facility record
postprocess-only export mappings bridge canonical instance ids to translated exported devices so downstream throughput audit can locate moved geometry without widening the canonical schema
mapped canonical commodities are translated into upstream recipe evidence so semantically resolvable facilities can emit precise IndustrialPlanner machine families
when an adapter-side outer deployment plan is supplied, canonical facility anchors are translated through explicit postprocess export mappings before serialization
when an adapter-side outer deployment plan is supplied, canonical orientation is translated through explicit postprocess export mappings before serialization
boundary port config item ids are translated into the IndustrialPlanner / upstream namespace before serialization
routing cells are flattened into target-side logistics devices
